candidates.title: Institutional context and the employment effects of artificial intelligence in European SMEs
candidates.summary: Institutional context and the employment effects of artificial intelligence in European SMEs. The association between AI use and employment growth is stronger in countries with higher innovation performance and governance quality, and weaker where employment protection is stricter and political centralisation is greater. Using novel data from the Survey on Access to Finance of Enterprises covering the last quarter of 2025 and an Inverse Probability Weighted Regression Adjustment approach, we assess the conditional treatment effects of artificial intelligence (AI) use on the likelihood of employment growth among Small and Medium-sized Enterprises across twelve EU countries, under selection on observable firm characteristics.
candidates.core_message: We find that AI use is associated with a positive conditional effect on the probability of employment growth.
